instruction_summary: Corrective study superseding the Hansen (2015) follow-ups 002+003: deduplicate the Florida STED ingest (5 files ingested twice), recompute every Florida density/balance/MDD/heaping number, retract the round-value-heaping caveat (a 0.000-reading artifact), report the honest versions of all audit-flagged reporting gates in 002, and in 003 delete-or-run the fabricated in-sample claim, present the sign model as persisted, compute the T3-H prediction from the model, and fix the 001 restatements.

steps.description: Read provenance audit (authoritative), 002/003 code, results, cards, reports, parquet shards, manifest
Rebuild /workspace/.venv (pandas/numpy/statsmodels/scipy/matplotlib/pyarrow) and point R_LIBS at the 002 rlib (rdrobust/rddensity/RDHonest)
steps.command: uv venv /workspace/.venv && uv pip install pandas numpy statsmodels matplotlib scipy pyarrow

steps.description: Verify parquet rows map 1:1 to manifest rows in processing order (100% src_year_month match); identify 5 duplicated sha256 files (+2,287 dup records)
Deduplicate: drop 2nd occurrence of each repeated sha256 -> 162,875 tests / 115,262 two-sample DUI / 530 files; rebuild fl_tests_deid.parquet, fl_analysis.csv, manifest, per-year counts
Recompute FL/WA density, MDD, power, pooled + by-year discrete tests (the by-year run 002 omitted) on deduplicated data
Recompute heaping EXCLUDING 0.000 readings (10.25% uniform vs 21% artifact), round-value check, cutoff-bin donut, gender balance on dedup data
Structural-audit honesty: per-field validity audit on 30 dedup pages/yr (two-extractor re-parse impossible: PDFs deleted, no fetch); report true rates + in-parquet reading range

003 corrective: compute T3-H prediction from the sign model + T0 codes, evaluate the uninformative clause, present sign model as persisted (+ disclosed record-split variant), RUN the in-sample appendix
Regenerate figures on dedup data; fix Finlay (annotate, not 0%); copy unchanged WA bandwidth curve
Write card_corrections.csv (old->corrected->reason, 28 rows incl. fabricated-claim row), findings.md, report.md, result_card.json

key_results.FL_0.08_power_margin_to_2xWA: FL 0.1978 vs 2xWA 0.1991 = -0.0013 (razor-thin; underpowered rule not triggered)
key_results.FL_lastdigit0_share: 10.25% excluding 0.000 readings (uniform); the ~21% was a 0.000-reading artifact (12.08% of tests)
key_results.FL_roundvalue_excess: none (cutoff ratio 1.05/1.02; 0.070/0.090/0.100 bins at or below neighbour mean) -> caveat RETRACTED
key_results.FL_field_validity_audit: 100% per field except n_valid_samples 99.44%; in-parquet readings all in [0,0.478] (two-extractor re-parse impossible)
key_results.theory_sign_model_persisted: severity 7/3/2 deter; record 2/0/2 ambiguous; mixed(Humphries) 0/0/1; monetary(Finlay) 0/1/0; 18 rows
key_results.theory_T3H_classification: 0.08 consistent; 0.15 strict consistent; 0.15 statutory consistent* (uninformative under a 2/3-supermajority reading; both 001 CIs include zero)
key_results.theory_insample_appendix: severity-class mean -37.7% -> -27.8% (LESS negative) when Hansen added; the fabricated '-more negative' claim was directionally wrong and had no code

deviations: Item 4 (genuine field-level two-extractor agreement check) cannot be done as written: the raw STED PDFs were deleted page-by-page at ingest (privacy design) and this study permits no new fetches. Substituted the closest defensible version: an in-parquet per-field validity audit on a 30-pages/year deduplicated sample (true rates reported; 99.44% n_valid_samples, readings all within [0,0.478]). No conclusion depends on this substitution.

0.15 statutory T3-H classification is borderline: consistent under a simple-majority reading of the pre-declared 'clear majority' (severity 7/12 deter), uninformative under a 2/3-supermajority reading. Both are reported; 001 cannot reject zero at this coding.
Washington Panel A was NOT re-estimated (unchanged; the audit verified the WA computation sound) - its values are reused verbatim from 002 results on disk.
In-sample appendix uses the paper's relative effects (-17/-9) to match the audit's -27.8% arithmetic; the 001-A1 variant (-27.7%) is reported alongside.

Ops (for the record): the orchestrator redacted transcript step [69] (a masked-page print exposing test day/time and masked surname lengths; no name disclosed) from the 002 transcript and host log on 2026-10-07, and deleted the host session copies; the audit's own quoted leak was likewise redacted from the staged audit copy, this study's transcript, and its log.
